_comment: Copy this file to 'skill_config.json' and fill in your organization's values. The skill's first-run setup can do this for you interactively. 'skill_config.json' is git-ignored so your settings are never committed. Environment variables (WIZ_PORTAL_URL, WIZ_API_URL, WIZ_API_TOKEN, SNOW_INSTANCE_URL) override these values when set.

_help.portal_url: For browser_sso: your organization's IdP-initiated SSO link to Wiz (Okta / Entra ID / Ping). Leave blank to pass --portal-url on the command line or set WIZ_PORTAL_URL.
_help.api_url: Your Wiz tenant GraphQL endpoint, e.g. https://api.<region>.app.wiz.io/graphql (login can capture this automatically).

_help.default_assignment_group: Fallback assignment group when no technical owner is known.
_help.idp_login_host: Optional: your SSO login host (e.g. login.microsoftonline.com, logon.example.com) so the ticket automation knows you are still on the IdP page and not yet in ServiceNow.

report.contact_line: For any clarification or support, please contact the SecOps team.

_help.team_name: How your security team is named in deliverables and ticket text.
_help.contact_line: First line of the Contact block at the end of Finding Summary.
_help.sign_off: Closing of the Contact block and of any ticket text. Use \n for line breaks. Set to "" to omit a sign-off entirely.

sla_days._comment: Days to remediate by severity, per YOUR organization's vulnerability-management policy. The values below are defaults, not requirements — change them to match your own SLA and every Target Remediation Date will follow. Keys beginning with _ are ignored.
